# PR2 T_ZQ: nested eject must rebase relative replaces of Go-only deps.
# Sibling eject keeps working; nested eject is the RED case.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Case: nested output inside the main module.
cd lapp
logos run .
stdout '^go-help-ok$'
cp stdout $WORK/a-stdout.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/go.mod
# The kept local replace must still resolve from the nested output.
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/a-stdout.txt

-- lapp/go.mod --
module example.com/lapp

go 1.27

require example.com/gohelp v1.0.0

replace example.com/gohelp v1.0.0 => ../gohelp

-- lapp/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/gohelp/h"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(h.Msg())
}

-- gohelp/go.mod --
module example.com/gohelp

go 1.27

-- gohelp/h/h.go --
package h

// Msg reports the Go helper string.
func Msg() string {
	return "go-help-ok"
}
